Organized by the Virginia Museum of History &Culture, Civil War Journey: Maps and Sketches of Private Robert Sneden, features more than 40 original works depicting his odyssey of combat, capture, imprisonment, and deliverance. Explore Hampton's integral ties to, and love of, the water that surrounds us, our seafood and maritime heritage, and passion for sailing as embodied in the locally developed Hampton One Design sailboat, and the sailing culture that grew out of it.
